summary: POSCO Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its English-translated interim report for the six months ended June 30, 2026, under cover of the SEC. The document is a routine periodic business report submitted to the Korean Financial Services Commission and Korea Exchange, containing standard operational, financial, and governance disclosures. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or management change is indicated. The filing is purely informational and does not trigger any special-situations classification.
